items.title: Seagate Stocks Fall 1.6% as Druckenmiller Filing Shows Stake Nearly Tripled Before Slide
items.summary: Duquesne lifted its Seagate position to 341,790 shares and added call options in the third quarter, before the shares nearly halved.

items.title: Sandisk Stocks Fall 5.43% as Druckenmiller Exit Surfaces Before 8-for-1 Split
items.summary: Duquesne sold its entire 34,900-share stake before September 30, and Sandisk's split takes effect after Thursday's close.

items.summary: Micron owns a far broader product mix, yet its shares are sinking right alongside the pure-play NAND maker. Is the market punishing every memory name on cycle fears, or did one analyst note just expose who is really at risk?

items.title: Druckenmiller Sold All of His Alphabet, AMD and SanDisk

items.title: There are 8 Reasons I’m Buying SanDisk Now at This Deep Discount

items.title: Seagate vs. Micron: Which AI Data Storage Stock is a Smarter Bet?

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller Nearly Tripled His Seagate Stake, Bought Western Digital and Sold All of His SanDisk. All Three Stocks Have Fallen Since
